summary: Feed c015_broker to NDR is severely degraded: 59.82% packet loss due to egress congestion on BROKER-A port 12. 1 Gbps delivery port is saturated (100% avg, bursts higher) while NDR can handle 10 Gbps.

findings.root_cause: BROKER-A port 12 egress port to NDR is undersized/oversubscribed: running at 100% of 1 Gbps average with bursts above line rate, causing the packet broker to tail-drop 15,953,520 packets (59.82% loss). Tool is 10 Gbps-capable but broker handoff is only 1 Gbps.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR loses ~60% of traffic, creating massive blind spot. Flow records and detections will be incomplete, state tracking breaks, and both-directions visibility required by NDR cannot be assured.

params.alternative: load_balance across multiple 1/10G ports or filter to reduce load

recommended_fix.why: Upgrade broker egress to match NDR 10 Gbps port speed to eliminate output discards; if immediate upgrade not possible, load-balance or filter to keep offered load <70% of egress capacity and absorb bursts.
